chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) judged regarding a man who cut off the breast of his wife. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Then he would be fined half a wergild for her'.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal ruling for the blood money of a severed breast?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the practical application of *diyah* (blood money) jurisprudence, specifically highlighting the distinct valuation of female breast injury as half the complete wergild. It reflects the Imam’s precise legal reasoning in categorizing injuries that are significant but not fatal, a key topic in Shia fiqh regarding compensation for bodily harm.

en.hubeali:
Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a man who cut off a breast of his wife. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then he would be fined half a wergild for her’.
